title: Looking for collab ( wild west city builder low poly )
author: Schumetzq
selftext:
Hello all! I am trying to build my wild west city builder game on godot with using claude max x5 and sol 5.6. I already implemented lots of systems and all but would really like to collabrate with someone with art part of the game since I dont have any experience with art part at all. I can show in a discord call about my gdd what i have done so far etc. 

Thanks all and good luck to you all with your projects
